content.title: Public Transit
content.summary: Arvada's mass transit options are provided by the Regional Transportation District (RTD), which includes the G Line Commuter Rail connecting the city to various metro areas and Denver International Airport. The G Line can be accessed at three locations in Arvada: Arvada Ridge Station, Gold Strike Station, and Olde Town Hub. Additionally, RTD offers a comprehensive bus route system and a call-n-ride service for curb-to-curb transportation within the city.
content.body:
## Mass Transit

The Regional Transportation District (RTD) provides Arvada with its mass transit options. For all information including all transit options, schedules, maps and more, visit [RTD](https://www.rtd-denver.com/).

## The G Line

The G Line Commuter Rail provides a transit option that connects Arvada to metro areas east, west, south and all the way to DIA. You can catch the G Line at three Arvada locations:

- [Arvada Ridge Station](/468/Arvada-Ridge-Station) (West Arvada)
- [Gold Strike Station](/469/Gold-Strike-Station) (East Arvada)
- [Olde Town Hub / Plaza](/473/Olde-Town-Hub-Olde-Town-Arvada-Station) (Olde Town Arvada)

## Bus Service / Call-n-Ride

A comprehensive bus route system that connects Arvada to the Denver Metropolitan area is available. A call-n-ride service that provides curb-to-curb transportation is also operated by RTD to serve Arvada. For more information including transit options, schedules, maps and more, visit [RTD](https://www.rtd-denver.com/).
